## Evidence integrity

- [ ] No fabricated evidence, metrics, screenshots or execution claims.
- [ ] Simulation/controlled work is explicitly labelled.
- [ ] Recommendations are separated from executed actions.
- [ ] Sensitive/private data has been removed or sanitized.
- [ ] README status matches retained evidence.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks executed.
- [ ] Required GitHub checks pass.
- [ ] Links reviewed.
- [ ] Scope and limitations documented.
